consequence.statement: Remote nodes always use the remote-node identity; no impact for users on the default true, but network policies based on enable-remote-node-identity=false need updating.
consequence.remediation: Update network policies that rely on enable-remote-node-identity=false.

assertion.statement: The deprecated Helm value remoteNodeIdentity was removed in 1.16; remote nodes now always use the remote-node identity, and network policies based on enable-remote-node-identity=false must be updated.
